correctness.rationale: For each positive-weight input Jacobian, the difference-of-window-CDF coefficients are strictly positive precisely on w consecutive edges, and telescope to column sum one. The exact identity D J=C D establishes contractivity. Overlap of all w-arc column supports when 2w>n forces strict triangle inequality on every nonzero zero-sum edge gradient; integration gives strict finite secants. Disjoint complete windows for n>=2w give equality, and a single dominant site yields the sharp unattained limiting factor otherwise. The w=n case is spatially constant. Rational checker validates the critical algebra for 792 cases, but unrestricted correctness rests on the proof.

originality.rationale: Nesterov provides the standard entropy-smoothed maximum and its probability-gradient formula but no finite-cycle variation equality classification. The inspected public finite-window morphology result addresses nonsmooth running maxima/minima on truncated nonperiodic paths, not cyclic entropy-smoothed windows, and proves attainable path constants rather than a half-cycle nonattainment threshold. The simple nonexpansivity bound is plausibly derivable from the max-filter result through the Gumbel maximum representation and is not asserted as the novel component. The exact if-and-only-if finite-pair attainment law, strictness at every finite pair for longer proper windows, and asymptotic sharpness were not found in actual searches; historical priority is nevertheless provisional.
residual_risks: The searched literature and public repository coverage are not exhaustive; unindexed earlier total-positivity or entropy-morphology results could cover the same equality classification.
The Goutsias–Heijmans full text and the entire historical stochastic-order literature were not examined; neither abstract provides a decisive covering statement.
The nonexpansive upper bound alone should not be cited as independently new because it follows from standard random-max representation together with suitable maximum-filter contraction.

value.rationale: The sharp half-cycle equality threshold for a natural entropy-smoothed dilation distinguishes exact nonexpansivity from pointwise strict contraction with no uniform gap. This natural boundary geometry and universal positive-temperature, positive-site-weight classification provide a reusable structural stability criterion and a precise comparison with unstable rank filters. Value rests on the equality classification and column-overlap mechanism, not on the routine fact that log-sum-exp smooths a maximum.
